description: Negative-benchmark fixture: web::Data<T> deref-wrapper class + same-file shadow class. PR #149 added recursive peeling of Arc/Rc/Box/Mutex/web::Data wrappers; from `entry(data: web::Data<AppState>)` the resolver should peel to AppState. Phase 3a (registry.Resolve consolidation, PR #158) added Tier 2 receiver-type discrimination, which eliminated the same-file shadow phantoms (`controls → AppState.record/flush`). All 6 cross-file method calls in `controls()` now emit correctly to MetricsCollector and Cache.

forbidden_emitted_calls.reason: Regression-prevention. `entry(data: web::Data<AppState>) { data.record(1); }` — PR #149's deref peeler resolves this to AppState.record. Binding to MetricsCollector.record would be a phantom from cross-package-heuristic if peeling regresses.
Regression-prevention. `data.flush()` should peel to AppState.flush. Binding to MetricsCollector.flush is a phantom.
Regression-prevention. Cache.record is the alternate shadow target out of scope from `entry`.
Regression-prevention. Cache.flush is the alternate shadow target out of scope from `entry`.

Regression-prevention (FIXED by Phase 3a). `controls()` calls `metrics.record(42)` and `cache.record("k")` — receiver types are MetricsCollector and Cache (let-bindings). Phase 3a's Tier 2 receiver-type discrimination filters bare-name candidates by parent class, so these now correctly bind to MetricsCollector.record and Cache.record. Binding to AppState.record from `controls` would mean Tier 2 regressed.
Regression-prevention (FIXED by Phase 3a). Same class as AppState.record above.
